notes.title: Version 0.5.3.60 - controller support, crash audio, camera shake and challenges!
notes.content:
Version 0.5.3.60 - 
added controller support for menus
crash audio now added
camera shake when crashing 
added challenges collect x number of orbs and try get close calls in specially designed runs

notes.title: Updated Cubefields 3 to be easier, Updated POD interior
notes.content:
[b]Cube Fields 3 Changes[/b]
Increased cube spawning distances for later stages.
Updated colours to be more visible.

[b]POD Update[/b]
Added pod controls that move when turning

[b]Future[/b]
Recently added a new obstacle fields type "Special" which allow me to spawn unique objects. I will be using this in the future vapourwaves worlds
